_note: Operator-declared editorial values for the Certification Package Overview (CPO-CSO-OVR: CDS-CSO-PUB, CDS-CSO-SVC, CDS-CSO-FID). scripts/build-cpo.py reads this plus the system profile, the CCM calendar and the canonical inventory and writes /.well-known/certification-package-overview.json in FedRAMP's schema. Where a value needs an outside party this proof of concept does not have (a FedRAMP ID, a SAM.gov UEI), the value is SIMULATED, says so, and the CPO flags it under providerExtensions.simulated. No published value here is an email address: contacts point to /.well-known/security.txt or the contact page.
fedramp_id_simulated: No FedRAMP ID exists or is coming: nothing has been submitted to FedRAMP. FedRAMP's schema says to use the provider's name and acronym until an ID is assigned; the suffix makes sure nobody mistakes it for one.
uei_simulated: Simulated. The operator is not registering on SAM.gov, so there is no Unique Entity Identifier; this value is a placeholder that no SAM.gov lookup will ever find.

service_description: A static personal website on AWS that doubles as a working continuous-compliance pipeline: every deploy derives signed, machine-readable compliance artifacts from one canonical inventory and publishes them under /.well-known/. Includes the Silk Reeling Mirror application, a Cognito-gated Tai Chi coaching API.
current_independent_assessment_service: None — self-attested; no FedRAMP-Recognized independent assessment service engaged (IVV is N/A for this unsponsored proof of concept).

cryptographic_modules.role: key store for all four customer-managed CMKs: at-rest (the compliance and watchdog Lambdas' environments and log groups, the DNS query log, the alert topic), runtime signing (the runtime signal), DNSSEC KSK, and the Silk Reeling app (its Lambda environment and log groups; the app holds no secrets since SCN-2026-006)
at-rest on the public website + log buckets

cryptographic_modules.validation: ECDSA P-256 (FIPS-approved algorithm); the implementations are NOT CMVP-validated modules
cryptographic_modules.compensating_control: trust anchored in the public Rekor transparency log

services.name: samaydlette.com static website
services.description: Public static content (S3 origin behind CloudFront), plus the signed compliance artifacts published under /.well-known/ and the trust center at /trust/.

security_category.rationale: Public content: nothing confidential. Integrity is moderate because defacement or tampering of published evidence would mislead readers. Availability is low: a personal site.

services.name: Silk Reeling Mirror application
services.description: Cognito-gated HTTP API (API Gateway -> Lambda) serving a browser SPA that coaches Tai Chi; writes feedback text from the scores in the Lambda, with no external interconnection (optional LLM feedback is customer-configurable and disabled here).

security_category.rationale: Holds invited users' sign-in accounts and the pose scores they submit, no federal data: confidentiality low. Integrity moderate: wrong coaching or tampered accounts are the harm. Availability low.

services.name: Continuous compliance evidence (pipeline trust root, runtime KSI emitter, evidence watchdog)
services.description: The deploy's trust root (OIDC roles, CloudFront, DNSSEC, remote state), the daily runtime re-validation of live configuration (signed runtime KSI signal), the hourly evidence-freshness watchdog with its alarms, and the audit trail and keys behind them. GitHub Actions and Sigstore, which build and sign the evidence, are third-party information resources inside the boundary.

security_category.rationale: The evidence is public by design. Integrity is moderate: false evidence is the harm this system exists to prevent. Availability is low.
